page.layout: Two oval portrait medallions centred at the top, one on the left and one on the right. Below them one column of running text. Page number at top right, running head at top centre. Signature at the foot on the right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: HYRCANUS Iamnei filius post matrem Alexandram apud Iudæos regnat non ita diu, nam frater eius Aristobulus minor natu, eum fugat: convenit tandem inter ipsos ut Hyr-canus privatum, Aristobulus Regem vivat. verum post an.6.à Pompeio Hyrcanus restituitur: & partim solus, partim cum Antipatro Herodis patre, administrat:tandē ei aures dentibus præcidit Antigonus.Iose.lib.14.ca.1.& 22.

ARISTOBULUS itaque regnat apud Iudæos anno mundi 3895. ante Christum natum 67. sed enim Hyrcanus tandem ad Pompeium Magnum confugiens,ab eodem iuvatur, cognita superbia ac iniuria Aristobuli: qui cum bellum Romanis inferre statueret,à Pompeio Ierosolymis prævetus, obsidetur:ad quē supplex egreditur,pecuniamq; promittit: quā cum primores dare recusarent,relicto Rege Aristobulo apud Pompeium,urbem claudūt,eósque introitu arcent.æstuas ira Pompeius, Aristobulum ligat:atq; urbē magnis viribus dum oppugnat,hæc ab iis qui Hyrcano fauebant,Pompeio traditur:templúmq; tertio postquam obsederat mēse oppugnat Pompeius, M. Tullio Cicerone,& M. Antonio Romæ Cos. Hircanum summum Sacerdote appellat: Aristobulum cum duabus filia-bus filio uno(alter enim filius Alexander effugerat)vinctos Ro-mam abducit.tum primùm Romanis subiiciuntur Iudæi.Iosephi.li.Anti.14.à 1.cap.ad 9.& de bel.Iud.li.1.cap.5.Post annum aufu-git Aristobulus à Roma in Iudæam, & regnū iterum affectans, à Gabinio captus, & secundò Romam vinctus missus est: tan-dem à Cæsare liberatus,præmisúsq; in Iudæam,à Pompeianis veneno necatur.Ægesip.li.1.

page.notes: Two medallion portraits, both with inscriptions around the rim, not transcribed as text. Left medallion: "8 D. IVD." on the left rim and "II HIRCANVS" on the right rim. Right medallion: "9 D. IVDEOR." on the left rim and "II ARISTOBOLVS" on the right rim. Spaced capitals at the start of each entry (HYRCANUS, ARISTOBULUS) are set as the lead-in of a paragraph, so they are kept inside the paragraph, not as headings. Their V's are read as U as they are vowels. No doubtful readings in the text.
